tests.title: Re-analysis of transfusion counts by volume with the unit threshold held fixed

predictions.magnitude: at least 0.5 fewer transfusions per infant

tests.compatible_with_both: A difference between -0.5 and -0.2 transfusion per infant.
tests.unexpected_under_both: More transfusions with the larger volume.

decisive_intervention.description: Use only randomised arms at one fixed threshold; negative control: number of blood gas samples, linked to neither hypothesis.

sensitivity.expected_noise: SD of the count about 0.9 per infant (from the closest trial)
sensitivity.replications: the infants of the randomised arms
sensitivity.simulation_not_applicable: Counts per infant are small integers with excess zeros; the normal model of sim.py does not fit.

decision_rule.continue_if: Difference below -0.5 with its 95% CI below 0.

feasibility.data: published arm-level counts of the randomised trials
feasibility.technical_risk: arm-level data only; thresholds poorly reported

l0_leakage_control.why_not: No language model judges anything in this test.

proxy_vs_target.target: donor exposure per infant over the stay
proxy_vs_target.how_kept_apart: Donor exposure is reported separately when given; no claim beyond counts.

variants.selection_rule_fixed_before: One volume contrast (20 versus 15 mL/kg), fixed before reading any count.

positive_control.description: Haemoglobin after transfusion must be higher at 20 mL/kg in the same data.
positive_control.distinguishes_bug_from_refutation: Without that rise the extraction is wrong, and a null count says nothing about H2.

data_split.design_data: the crossover trial used to set the noise
data_split.separation: The crossover trial is excluded from the confirmation set by identifier.

ranking.basis: value of information for the next decision relative to cost

scenarios.name: volume matters
scenarios.if: the count falls with the larger volume
scenarios.then: propose the protocol change to the unit
scenarios.why: The lever is in the unit's hands.

scenarios.name: threshold matters
scenarios.then: drop the volume idea and study thresholds
scenarios.why: The volume would then carry no gain.
